title: vedanānaṃ pariññā
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
“Bhikkhus, there are these three vedanā.
What three? Pleasant vedanā, painful vedanā,
neither-painful-nor-pleasant vedanā.
These are the three vedanā.
The four establishments of awareness are to be developed for the full understanding of these three vedanā.”
